title: 15 Pigs Just Took Over A New Jersey Highway
text:
Fifteen pigs just shut down a New Jersey highway.

New Jersey State Police responded to Route 565 in Frankford Township, Sussex County Wednesday morning to find a full herd loose and wandering across traffic. No one was hurt, but plenty of commuters had a very confusing commute.

Turns out a damaged fence back at the farm let all fifteen out at once. Police, animal control, and the owner spent the morning walking them back home, one pig at a time.
